comment: Which font draws each of the maps' font tags (port/linux/src/text_hires.c): role is which of the player's fonts stands in for it (display.high_res_font_large for large, display.high_res_font for both) and which of Online Games' menu faces it is; width is how wide its glyphs are drawn (1: as the font has them). The first large and the first small font are the overlay's menu faces (tools/embed_assets.py).
